Belarus Releases Political Prisoners After US Envoy Visit

Belarus released 25 political prisoners following a visit by a US envoy. The release occurred after the US lifted sanctions on Belarus. The Jerusalem Post and Euronews reported on the prisoner release, with Euronews specifying the number of individuals freed and linking it to the US envoy's visit.
